messages.content: 你能告訴我克里斯蒂亞諾·羅納度在英超聯賽的曼聯俱樂部的歷史進球數，然後將其與曼聯在同一聯賽中的最佳射手進行比較，最後告訴我誰是2019-2020賽季英超聯賽的最佳射手嗎？

function.name: team_stats_get_top_scorer
function.description: Fetch the top scorer of a specified football team. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: league_stats_get_top_scorer
function.description: Fetch the top scorer of a specified football league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

season.description: Season for which to fetch stats (optional). Default is '2019-2020' if not specified.

competition.description: Competition for which to fetch stats (optional). Default is 'Premier League' if not specified.

message.reasoning:
The user asks:

"Can you tell me Cristiano Ronaldo's total goal count at Manchester United in Premier League? Then compare it with Manchester United's best striker in same league. Finally tell who was the Premier League top scorer in 2019-2020 season."

We need data from functions.

First get Ronaldo's all time goals for Man Utd in Premier League. Use player_stats_get_all_time_goals with competition "Premier League". Next we need Manchester United's top scorer in Premier League. That could use team_stats_get_top_scorer with team_name "Manchester United", competition "Premier League".

Then find Premier League top scorer 2019-20 using league_stats_get_top_scorer with season "2019-2020".

We'll call each function accordingly.
